A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Harmony and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices. Material can be matched reliably across additions, revisions, and relocations.

before.justification: v2 reports original classification, segmentation, detection, retrieval, and ablation results, including experiments in its appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains those original experiments and adds SILC and DetailCLIP comparisons, CC12M results, and a reported DINOv2 reproduction outcome.

M1.justification: The five-objective architecture remains, but the stated distillation procedure is corrected: Section 3.2 now sends unmasked images to the teacher and masked images to the student, reversing v2's description. Text-distillation targets are corrected similarly. These revise the specified procedure without establishing an implementation change.

E1.justification: v3 adds CC12M as a pretraining corpus while retaining the existing downstream datasets and task families. The YFCC15M training-failure example in v2 Appendix F disappears. Coverage remains centered on web image-caption pretraining and general visual tasks.

E2.justification: SILC and DetailCLIP substantially expand the evaluated comparator set across downstream tasks, eight-dataset zero-shot classification, and image-text retrieval in v3 Tables 1–3. SigLIP already appeared in v2 Table 1. DINOv2 is discussed as an unsuccessful reproduction excluded from the comparison tables.

E3.justification: Figure 3(b) introduces a data-size comparison using ViT-B with CC3M, a 6M-image CC12M subset, and full CC12M. Existing CC3M training, downstream evaluation, and equal-compute protocols remain unchanged. Appendix A's added zero-shot implementation description does not establish a protocol switch.

E4.justification: v3 adds data-volume sensitivity analysis and a DINOv2 reproduction-failure discussion, while removing v2's mixed-precision failure analysis. Component ablations, loss-weight and batch-size studies, masking and augmentation analyses, equal-compute comparisons, and qualitative examples are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or formal significance tests. v3 retains the same point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: Existing table scores are retained, but substantial new comparator and CC12M results appear. SILC ties Harmony's ViT-B ImageNet zero-shot score at 23.3 and approaches its eight-dataset average, 32.7 versus 32.9. Harmony's benchmark wins change from six to five of eight because the comparator set expands. Figure 3(b) newly shows its advantage narrowing with more data.

T1.justification: Section 3.1 removes an extra softmax around P when defining teacher targets. Equations 8 and 12 correct masked versus unmasked inputs, and Equation 11 reverses the cross-entropy arguments to put the target first. These are non-equivalent mathematical corrections; no new theorems or proofs appear.

C1.justification: The central general-purpose representation claim remains. v3 adds suitability for data-constrained settings and a composable-codebase contribution, restricts the no-negative-examples claim to the self-supervised path, and qualifies overall superiority as superior or competitive performance, reflecting the SILC comparisons.

C2.justification: v3 interprets the shrinking data-scaling advantage as potentially reflecting harder gains at higher accuracy or greater benefits of additional data for CLIP. Appendix G explains DINOv2's exclusion through a suspected, unidentified implementation problem. Conversely, v2's discussion of mixed-precision instability and unresolved YFCC15M failures is removed.

D1.justification: v3 adds pseudocode with per-loss backward passes, zero-shot prompting and teacher-text-encoder details, and information about a composable codebase and SILC implementation. It removes the AdamW beta2 adjustment to 0.98 and precision-exception disclosures from v2 Appendix F. Most architecture, hyperparameter, hardware, and training details remain.

R1.justification: v3 adds references and discussion for SILC, DetailCLIP, and SigLIP, positioning Harmony's five objectives against closer joint-learning approaches. It also expands discussion of the already-cited DINOv2. The broader related-work organization and existing research lineage remain intact.

P1.justification: There are localized language and terminology edits, revisions to the abstract and contributions, and added explanations. Retrieval discussion moves from Appendix B into Section 4.2, and appendix organization changes. The main section order and most method and ablation prose are retained.

P2.justification: Figure 1 adds comparator bars, Figure 3 gains a data-scaling panel, and Table 1 is regrouped by model size. Retrieval moves into the main text with expanded rows; a CC12M table and pseudocode display are added. The overall visual format and other figures remain largely unchanged.

improvement.justification: Stronger comparator coverage, more qualified claims, data-scaling evidence, and corrected loss equations provide a limited net improvement in credibility and clarity. These gains are tempered by removal of useful mixed-precision troubleshooting and unexplained CC12M averages in Table 8: the reported 36.6 and 39.6 differ from the listed scores' arithmetic means of approximately 39.1 and 41.0.
